name: Registration 2 Code
definition: Specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt.

PTYH.name: Party Hold
PTYH.definition: You or your party set the instruction in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode.

CSDH.name: CSD Hold
CSDH.definition: Central securities depository sets the instruction in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode.

CDEL.name: Conditional Delivery
CDEL.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode as it fulfils predefined conditional delivery rules in the market infrastructure platform for conditional delivery.

CVAL.name: CSD Validation
CVAL.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode as it fulfils predefined conditions of a restriction processing type in the market infrastructure platform.
